mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing mainly clear skies and a pleasant 82 degrees near Verona Area High School. Conditions are perfect for sky watching tonight, with a beautiful waxing crescent moon and a visible pass of the International Space Station starting at 9:31 PM.

If you are interested in home composting but live in an apartment, the City of Verona has convenient options. You can drop off your food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located at 1220 East Verona Avenue, or check out composting resources from the University of Wisconsin-Madison Extension and Dane County Ripple Effects.

We have an exciting lineup of local events coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie on July 19th, Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 20th, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returning to Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In our weekly police report, on Friday, July 10th, Verona officers conducted a traffic stop where K9 Drea alerted to the presence of drugs, resulting in citations for driving with a suspended license and possession of marijuana.

The Verona Culver's is currently closed and will reopen tomorrow morning at 10 AM. While tomorrow's flavor of the day is unconfirmed, it is a perfect opportunity to stop by and surprise yourself with a delicious fresh scoop.
